sections.title: AI Services for New York eCommerce Organizations
sections.description: Custom AI built specifically for New York's distinctive eCommerce market — fashion, luxury, and omnichannel retail.

items.title: Product Recommendation Engine
items.description: Custom collaborative filtering and content-based recommendation models trained on your specific customer purchase history, browsing behavior, and product catalog — outperforming platform vendor recommendations on your specific New York customer demographics and purchase patterns. Two-stage retrieval + ranking architecture that scales from thousands to millions of catalog items. A/B testing infrastructure included. Typical cost: $40,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 12–20 weeks.
items.label: Recommendation

items.title: AI-Powered Search and Discovery
items.description: Neural semantic search that understands what shoppers mean ('flowy summer dress for a beach wedding') not just keywords they type — reducing zero-result searches and surfacing relevant products even when catalog taxonomy doesn't match natural language queries. Particularly impactful for New York fashion and luxury brands with nuanced product attributes. Typical cost: $35,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
items.label: Semantic search

items.title: Visual Search and Multimodal Commerce
items.description: Enabling shoppers to find products by uploading a photo — 'find me something like this' — using CLIP-based cross-modal embeddings. High-ROI for fashion, home décor, and beauty categories where visual similarity is central to how customers discover products. Typical cost: $50,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Visual search

items.title: Demand Forecasting and Inventory Optimization
items.description: ML time-series models predicting product demand by SKU, channel, and location — enabling smarter inventory positioning across New York's complex omnichannel operations (store, warehouse, fulfillment center, 3PL). Reduces both out-of-stock (lost sales) and overstock (markdowns) simultaneously. Typical cost: $45,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 12–20 weeks.
items.label: Demand forecasting

items.title: AI-Powered Personalization
items.description: Full-funnel personalization beyond product recommendations — personalizing homepage content, email campaigns, push notifications, and pricing offers based on individual customer predicted preferences and value. Particularly high-impact for New York's high-LTV luxury and premium DTC brands where personalization investment ROI is clearest. Typical cost: $55,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 14–22 weeks.
items.label: Personalization

items.title: Customer Service Automation
items.description: LLM-powered virtual assistants for New York's high-volume eCommerce customer service — handling order status, returns, product questions, and size/fit guidance with clean escalation to human agents. Manages the customer service volume of high-traffic sale events (New York Fashion Week seasons, holiday peaks) without proportional headcount. Typical cost: $25,000–$70,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
items.label: Customer service AI

items.answer: Yes — ML forecasting explicitly models seasonal patterns, fashion week cycles, and promotional lift — enabling smarter pre-season buys and markdown optimization.

items.answer: Yes — ClickMasters builds API-first AI that integrates with your existing commerce platform via standard APIs.

items.question: Can visual search work for our home goods catalog?
items.answer: Yes — home décor is one of the strongest visual search use cases alongside fashion; visual similarity search enables customers to find items matching their existing room aesthetic.

items.answer: Yes — ClickMasters builds retraining pipelines that update models as new products are added and purchase behavior evolves, keeping recommendations current without manual intervention.
